cesium.hint: Adjust CesiumJS 3D Tiles rendering parameters. Changing values reloads 3D layers.
cesium.sse.hint: Larger values load fewer tiles and render faster. Smaller values are more detailed.
cesium.maxMemory.hint: Cache memory limit for 3D Tiles. Smaller values cause more tile reloading.
cesium.dynamicSse.hint: When ON, distant tiles are automatically coarsened, keeping high-altitude views fast.
cesium.cullChildren.hint: When ON, unneeded parent tiles are excluded using child tile bounds, reducing render load.
cesium.preferLeaves.hint: When ON, the most detailed leaf tiles load first. Tends to be heavier.
cesium.skipLod.hint: When ON, intermediate LODs are skipped to reach the target resolution faster.
google.gemini.hint: Settings for the Gemini API (AI chat). Enter a key issued at Google AI Studio.
google.gemini.security: Security: the key is stored only in the browser's localStorage and is sent only to Google's API endpoint (HTTPS). However, the key appears in request URLs, so it is visible to anyone using this PC, browser extensions, and scripts on the page. Intended for local, personal use — do not deploy to public servers or share with third parties. Restricting the key to "Generative Language API only" in Google Cloud is recommended.
google.maps.hint: API key for Google Maps Platform. Enter a key issued at Google Cloud Console. Used for geocoding, Places, Photorealistic 3D Tiles, and other map features.
google.maps.security: Security: the key is stored only in the browser's localStorage. Use a separate key from the Gemini key. Restrict it to "Map Tiles API only" (etc.) in Google Cloud, and add HTTP referrer restrictions where possible. Usage is billed — setting budget alerts is recommended.
google.tiles3dHint: When ON, Google's photorealistic 3D tiles are added to the layer list automatically using the saved Maps API key. Map Tiles API usage fees apply.
google.needKey: Save the Maps API key first.

chat.noApiKey:
No API key set. Save a Gemini API key in the Google → Gemini tab to chat. Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
Available commands: /fly /layers /layer /basemaps /basemap /search /camera
chat.systemInstruction: You are an operation assistant for the 3D map app "KASUGAI Canvas". Operate the map with tools according to user instructions. If a layer name is ambiguous, check with listLayers; if a basemap name is ambiguous, check with listBasemaps, and use the closest match. switchProject, applyInspector, shutdownApp, installUpdate, and exportInspector are high-impact operations — run them only when the user explicitly asks, and confirm before executing. You can also extend the app itself: generate a plugin module (export async function init(api, manifest){}) and save it with savePlugin; the user reviews the code before it is applied, and if loading fails the reason is returned so you can fix it via getPluginCode and save again. For data tasks, fetch external data with fetchData or read loaded layers with getLayerGeoJson, transform it with runCode, then display it with addDataLayer (simplestyle properties in feature properties control styling). On the local server version, a reviewed plugin can be promoted to the distributed PLUGIN/ folder with publishPlugin (a high-impact operation — only when the user asks). Answer briefly in English.
